title: Retry webhook deliveries with backoff
spec: Retry network errors and 5xx responses up to 5 attempts with exponential backoff starting at 2s, capped at 2 minutes. Stop when the context is cancelled.
acceptance_criteria: the delay doubles from 2s and never exceeds 2 minutes
cancelling the context stops retrying immediately

defects.note: the delay is never capped at maxDelay
